# symbolicUserTorsionalTurnsTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicUserTorsionalTurnsTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserTorsionalTurnsTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  CreateTorsionalSpringDamper of UserItemCreator with unlimitedRotations (#3218): the angle continues over the
#           turns by a data node of the connector, which its post-Newton step sets to the angle of the step, as
#           ObjectConnectorTorsionalSpringDamper does. A free disc, started at 20 rad/s about its axis z against a soft
#           torsional spring to the ground, turns by about 3.5 rad - beyond pi, where the angle in (-pi, pi] jumps -
#           and swings back; the Python and the recorded user items against mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper, by
#           generalized-alpha and RK44, SymbolicSystem by SolveGeneralizedAlpha and SolveExplicit against SolveDynamic,
#           and the angle in (-pi, pi] of unlimitedRotations=False giving another motion. The result is the final angular velocity of the
#           generalized-alpha solution plus the number of checks that pass.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-02
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.symbolics.systemModel import SymbolicSystem
from exudyn.symbolics.solvers import SolveExplicit, SolveGeneralizedAlpha
import numpy as np

def Build(userItems, record=False, unlimitedRotations=True):
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) if userItems else mbs
    ground = creator.CreateGround()
    disc = creator.CreateRigidBody(inertia=InertiaCylinder(density=1000, length=0.02, outerRadius=0.1, axis=2),
                                   referencePosition=[0, 0, 0], initialAngularVelocity=[0, 0, 20],
                                   nodeType=exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz)
    creator.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[ground, disc], position=[0, 0, 0], axis=[0, 0, 1], stiffness=0.1,
                                        damping=0.002, unlimitedRotations=unlimitedRotations)
    if record:
        creator.Record()
    mbs.variables['creator'] = creator #the recordings live as long as the system
    mbs.Assemble()
    return (SC, mbs, disc)

simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 2000
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 1
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.useModifiedNewton = False
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False

def State(mbs, disc):
    """the angular velocity about z and the position of a point on the rim"""
    return np.array([mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(disc, exu.OutputVariableType.AngularVelocity, localPosition=[0, 0, 0])[2]]
                    + list(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(disc, exu.OutputVariableType.Position, localPosition=[0.1, 0, 0])))

passed = 0
for solverType in [exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha, exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44]:
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.solverType = solverType
    results = []
    for (userItems, record) in [(False, False), (True, False), (True, True)]:
        (SC, mbs, disc) = Build(userItems, record)
        mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
        results.append(State(mbs, disc))
    difference = max(np.max(np.abs(results[1] - results[0])), np.max(np.abs(results[2] - results[0])))
    (SC, mbs, disc) = Build(True, True)
    system = SymbolicSystem(mbs)
    if solverType == exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha:
        SolveGeneralizedAlpha(system, simulationSettings)
    else:
        SolveExplicit(system, simulationSettings, solverType=solverType)
    differenceSystem = np.max(np.abs(State(mbs, disc) - results[2]))
    (SC, mbs, disc) = Build(True, False, unlimitedRotations=False)
    mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
    differenceLimited = np.max(np.abs(State(mbs, disc) - results[1]))
    exu.Print(str(solverType) + ': angular velocity and rim point at t=1', results[0], ', user items against built-in',
              difference, ', SymbolicSystem against SolveDynamic', differenceSystem, ', without the turns', differenceLimited)
    passed += int(difference < 1e-9) + int(differenceSystem < 1e-9) + int(differenceLimited > 1e-2)
    if solverType == exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha:
        u = results[0][0]

u += passed
exu.Print('solution of symbolicUserTorsionalTurnsTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
